mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor market, as measured by increasing non-farm payrolls, signals stronger economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by >100,000 jobs monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth and monthly housing starts indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 declines from prior quarter and HOUST falls from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by >0.5% monthly during late-cycle expansion.
